issue.title: Cannot follow 307/308 HTTP redirects in verbose mode if request body is being streamed
issue.body:
**Checklist**

- [x] I've searched for similar issues.
- [x] I'm using the the latest version of HTTPie.

---

**What are the steps to reproduce the problem?**

1. Create a file with some content `echo 'hello world' | file.txt`
2. Run ` http --follow -v post pie.dev/redirect-to url==https://pie.dev/post status_code==307 @file.txt`

**What is the expected result?**

HTTPie should be able to follow any 307/308 HTTP redirect and print intermediate requests/responses.

**What happens instead?**

HTTPie hangs for a while before throwing a connection error

**Debug output**

Please re-run the command with `--debug`, then copy the entire command & output and paste both below:

```
$ http --follow -v --debug post pie.dev/redirect-to url==https://pie.dev/post status_code==307 @cli-tools-i-use.txt
```
